title: The Winter Pass
tagline: Cross the mountains and return before the snow closes the road.
intro: The village granary burned at the end of autumn. The only grain left lies across the mountains, at the monastery of Highcrest. A small company must fetch it and return before the first snowfall seals the pass for months.
goal: Bring the grain back from Highcrest monastery before the snow closes the pass.
questions: What destroyed the granary, and whom does the village blame?
Why won't the monastery simply hand over the grain?
What do people say about the pass that nobody dares say aloud?
Who in the village would rather see the company fail?
difficulties: The snow will come earlier than expected
The monks want something in return
Someone in the village is sabotaging the expedition
Only one person in the company knows the way
The load is too heavy to return quickly
desires: Prove I am not a coward
Repay a debt to the village
Win back the respect I lost
Learn what happened to the one who crossed and never came back

challenges.title: Convince the council
challenges.text: The village must lend mules and supplies it can barely spare.

challenges.title: The old bridge
challenges.text: It is guarded, or rotten, or both.

challenges.title: The storm
challenges.text: Shelter and lose days, or press on blind.

challenges.title: Bargain with the abbot
challenges.text: The monastery has mouths to feed too.

challenges.title: An injury on the road
challenges.text: Someone gets hurt and slows everyone down.

challenges.title: The loaded return
challenges.text: Slower, wearier, and racing the weather.

challenges.title: The bandits
challenges.text: They want the grain, or they want someone in the company.

challenges.title: The last night
challenges.text: One day from home, something changes everything.

title: Meridian Station
tagline: Keep an orbital station alive until relief arrives.
intro: Meridian Station orbits a gas giant months away from any port. The relief ship has just announced a forty-day delay, and the station's systems were never meant to last that long. The crew has to hold on.
goal: Keep Meridian Station's crew alive until relief arrives.
questions: What is the station researching that the company cares so much about?
Why is the relief ship late?
Which part of the station does nobody visit?
Who aboard has orders the others don't know about?
difficulties: The air recycler fails every few days
The company puts the data before the crew
A storm on the planet cuts communications
Someone aboard is not on the manifest
The autopilot has plans of its own
desires: Make the company pay for this
Finally be the one who decides
Make sure nobody learns what I did

challenges.title: Rationing
challenges.text: Decide who gets what when there isn't enough.

challenges.title: Fix the recycler
challenges.text: Slow, dangerous work outside the hull.

challenges.title: Restore contact
challenges.text: The antenna must be aligned mid-storm.

challenges.title: Mutiny
challenges.text: Part of the crew wants to abandon the station.

challenges.title: Company orders
challenges.text: A message arrives that changes everything.

challenges.title: Decaying orbit
challenges.text: The station begins falling toward the planet.

challenges.title: Relief arrives
challenges.text: But there isn't room for everyone.
